arabic text: KAHA ROKE BAQIR NE ABID SE BABA\nSAKINA KO KYON CHOR KAR JA RAHE HAI\nHAI BABA YAHAN PAR BADA SA ANDHERA
english translation text: BAQIR CRIED TO ABID, 'O FATHER‘\nWHY ARE WE LEAVING SAKINA HERE\nO FATHER IT IS VERY DARK HERE

arabic text: HA DEKHA HAI MAINE SAFAR MAY YE MANZAR\nJAHAN PANI HOTA THA USKO MAYASSAR\nTO KHUD APNE HISSAY KA PANI HAMESHA
english translation text: I SAW THIS SCENE DURING THE JOURNEY\nWHENEVER SHE WAS PRESENTED WITH WATER\nSHE ALWAYS SACRIFICED HER PORTION OF WATER

arabic text: GIRAATI THI YE AAP KE BAYDIYO PAR\nMAYASSAR HAI AB HUMKO PANI TO PYASA
english translation text: AND POURED IT ON THE CHAINS ON YOUR FEET\nO THIRSTY ONE WE NOW HAVE WATER

arabic text: JHUKAYE HUE APNA SAR RO RAHI HAI\nRIHAAI KI SUNKAR KHABAR RO RAHI HAI\nTADAPTI HAI DADI RUBAB AISE BABA
english translation text: BOWING HER HEAD SHE IS CRYING\nSHE IS CRYONG ON HEARING ABOUT OUR FREEDOM\nSUCH IS GRANDMOTHER RUBAB'S TREMBLING

arabic text: KE AMMA BHI THAME JIGAR RO RAHI HAI\nBATAYENGE KYA GAR UNHONE YE POOCHA
english translation text: THAT MOTHER IS ALSO CRYING CLUTCHING HER CHEST\nWHAT WILL WE SAY WHEN PEOPLE ASK US

arabic text: MUJHE YAAD HAI KHUD YE KEHTE THAY DADA\nMADINA HAI ISKE SABAB SE MADINA\nKE MERI NAZAR WO GHAR GHAR NAHI HAI
english translation text: I REMEMBER GRANDFATHER USED TO SAY\nMADINA IS MADINA DUE TO HER\nIN MY EYES A HOUSE IS NOT A HOUSE

arabic text: NAZAR JISME AAYE NA MUJKO SAKINA\nNA USKE BINA PHIR BASEGA MADINA
english translation text: WHERE SAKINA IS NOT PRESENT\nHOW WILL MADINA BE THE SAME WITHOUT HER

arabic text: MUJHE AAJ YAAD AA RAHA HAI WO LAMHA\nGIRI THI JO NAAQE SE EK DIN SAKINA\nLAGE AAP KI PUSH TP AR TAAZIYANE
english translation text: TODAY I REMEMBER THE TIME\nWHEN SAKINA FELL FROM THE CAMEL'S BACK\nYOUR BACK WAS LASHED WITH WHIPS

arabic text: MAGAR AAPNE KHAAFILA ROKE RAKHA\nRUKAALE YUHI KHAAFILA AAJ BABA
english translation text: BUT YOU WERE DETERMINED TO STOP THE CARAVAN\nMAKE THE CARAVAN STOP TODAY

arabic text: ACHANAK NIGAHEIN PADI JO LAHAD PAR\nSAWALAAT PHIR LAB PE AAYE NA AKBAR\nSAKINA KI TURBAT KO SEENE LAGAYE
english translation text: SUDDENLY MY GAZE FELL ON HER TINY GRAVE\nMAY SALAWAT NOT BE UTTERED FROM MY LIPS\nHUGGING SAKINA'S GRAVE

arabic text: PADAR SE YE KEHNE LAGE ROKE BAQIR\nSAMAJH MAY MERI AB HAI BABA YE AAYA
english translation text: BAQIR WEPT TO HIS FATHER\nI NOW UNDERSTAND O FATHER (THE SHE HAS PASSED AWAY)
